places.summary: The Columbia began as a corner saloon opened in 1903 and became a restaurant in 1905; it now fills a city block of Ybor City with 15 dining rooms and seating for up to 1,700. heritage.story: Spanish-Cuban immigrant Casimiro Hernandez Sr. helped open the Columbia Saloon on Dec. 17, 1903, and it became the Columbia Restaurant in 1905. The 1903 corner saloon is today's Cafe Dining Room, still using the original bar. Dining rooms were added over the century: the Don Quixote Room of 1935 was Tampa's first air-conditioned dining room, El Patio followed in 1937 and the Siboney Room opened on New Year's Eve 1955. The restaurant is still owned and run by the founder's descendants.
heritage.visiting: Open daily for lunch and dinner; flamenco shows are booked through the restaurant's website.

report:
# eat-tampa: where to eat and drink in Tampa and Around the Bay

1. **MICHELIN Guide data.** guide.michelin.com HTML pages sit behind an AWS bot challenge (curl, WebFetch and a browser all fail), so the Tampa selection was read from the guide's own public search index (the Algolia index the site queries; every hit says `guide_year: 2026`, published 2026-05-28, updated July 2026) and cross-checked against https://www.visittampabay.com/michelin/, which lists the same 28 restaurants with the same distinctions. The Wikipedia list of Florida starred restaurants confirms the star history (Lilac 2023–2025 only). Each Michelin record lists its guide.michelin.com restaurant URL in `also_sources` for the verifier.
2. **Visit Tampa Bay listings.** Paged through all 262 EAT listings plus Breweries & Distilleries, Nightlife, Entertainment & Nightlife, Bakeries/Desserts, Coffee Shops, Multicultural and "Only in Tampa Bay" through the site's listings API, and read its Cuban sandwich guide (https://www.visittampabay.com/food-and-drink/cuban-sandwich/) and Michelin page.
3. **Names from the brief and local knowledge**, each confirmed on its own site.
4. **Official sites** were read with curl, WebFetch or a headless browser (for script-built sites, SiteGround captchas and age gates). 65 of 72 records cite the business's own page as `source_url`; 6 cite the Visit Tampa Bay listing because the official site was blocked or down (Alessi, The Brisket Shoppe, CW's Gin Joint, Independent Bar, Jackson's Bistro, Blind Tiger Ybor), and 1 cites the Michelin page (Flaming Mountain).
